selection_policy: Retain every numbered raw Callgrind dump and the zero-Ir Program termination part. Select the measured part only from a positive raw incoming edge whose caller is ordinary_save::run_case; generated counting publication has one additional semantic_docx_bytes setup serialization, while the admitted real fixture has four atomic reference saves. Preserve unexpected callers as warnings.
scope: Callgrind Ir guest-instruction attribution for the direct ordinary-save edit owner and the DOCX write_plain serializer. The edit owner includes document_mut admission and mutation; the publication owner includes one package serialization call. Setup probes and reference publications are retained for edge proof and excluded from the measured row.
claim: Attribution only; Callgrind Ir is a guest-instruction mechanism diagnostic and is not native latency, hardware-cycle, allocation-count, RSS, cache-counter, or production-change evidence.
